messages:
Maria Chen: Quick proposal — add a lightweight auth proxy that mints short-lived delegated tokens for long-lived service keys so routing/quota/telemetry live in one place. Thoughts?

Jared Patel: Why a proxy? Can we instead extend the router to accept scoping headers? Proxy adds latency :thinking:

Maria Chen: Measured a microbenchmark: proxy + mint ~= 5-8ms tail in our sim, avg 3.8ms. Tradeoff: single enforcement point vs tiny extra hop.

Sasha Ivanov: How does this interact with existing token-exchange flow for user consent? Sounds similar.

Maria Chen: Proxy only for service keys. Flow:

```http
POST /mint
Authorization: Bearer svc_key_xxx
Body: {"target_service_account":"sa@app", "scope":"impersonate"}
```

Returns short token with claims: imp:sa@app, org:org_123, proj:proj_321. Client sends to runtime with headers:

```
Authorization: Bearer <delegated-token>
X-Redwood-Org: org_123
X-Redwood-Project: proj_321
```

This lets router apply org/project quotas and label telemetry consistently.

Jared Patel: For quotas — do we bill against org or project? Need per-route breakdown in console.

Maria Chen: We'll attribute to project by default, with org as rollup. Metrics: requests{service="embed", org="org_123", project="proj_321"}

Eve (infra): Audit requirement: every mint must be logged with requestor key id, nonce, and KMS op id. Also expose audit view in console.

Sasha Ivanov: RBAC: what if a service key is scoped to multiple projects or only a subset?

Maria Chen: Proxy will validate allowed project list (we already store key->scopes). If token request asks for disallowed project -> 403. Console UI idea: 'Service key scopes' panel showing allowed projects + an 'Allow impersonation across projects' toggle with force-consent.

InfraBot: deploy-checklist: perf-test ✅, e2e-auth ✳️, quota-sim pending. (add logs to /infra/logs/auth-proxy)

Jared Patel: Sounds good. Next steps: RFC + perf sig. I'll own perf testing. @Maria can you mock console panel and open RFC PR?

Maria Chen: Yep — will post RFC link and a screenshot by EOD. :+1:
